name: com.midmanstudio.proceduralterrain
description: Procedural low poly terrain from a seed: layered noise, island falloff, a jittered lattice or Poisson-disc points with Delaunay triangulation, terraces with vertical walls, flat or smooth shading, hand made stamps (pads, roads, rivers, mounds), patches and locks, and scatter for trees and rocks. A streaming manager with background threads and level of detail, a vertex colour shader for URP, an editor preview and baker. Every height is a pure function of the seed and a true position, so endless worlds are built chunk by chunk with no seams, in any order, on any thread. Standalone and game-agnostic.
